title: WWE Superstar Liv Morgan’s Looking for ‘Trouble’ in Her Music Video Ahead of WrestleMania 42
summary: She's slated to take on Stephanie Vaquer for the Women's World Championship at WrestleMania.
contentText:
Liv Morgan is ready for some trouble. The WWE superstar released her badass “Trouble” music video on Monday (April 13), just days ahead of her match for the Women’s World Championship at night one of WrestleMania 42 kicking off Saturday (April 18).

Fittingly rocking an “I Heart Trouble” T-shirt, Morgan is in troublemaking mode throughout the edgy visual. The 31-year-old lights a car on fire, wrecks a game of pool and gets a tattoo.

“Trouble, trouble, that’s me/ Cherry lips and bad energy/ Say it once, say it twice and I’ll give it to you all night,” she sings on the chorus.

The scene pivots to a grungy parking garage. Flanked by dancers draped in black attire, Morgan and the crew straddle chairs, which feels like something inspired by the Pussy Cat Dolls’ “Buttons” video.

Police invade the scene, and the former two-time Women’s World Champion gets apprehended. Even while battered and bloodied, Morgan maintains a devious smile. Her mugshot then gets snapped before she receives a knot on her forehead from a bump earlier this month.

Whether it’s music or wrestling, Liv Morgan is cool, calm and collected heading into her eighth WrestleMania.

“I feel like since I’ve come back from my injury, I’m very much just trying to stay in the moment and be present,” she told Insight Wth Chris Van Vliet on April 9. “Obviously, WrestleMania is heavy on my mind, but I’m not feeling any anxiety or pressure yet. I’m just kind of taking everything day by day and just preparing as best as I can. So no, I don’t feel pressure right now in this moment.”

Morgan has dabbled in the music world in the past, and was one of the many who pulled up to Coachella over the weekend out in the Palm Springs desert.

The New Jersey native told Billboard in 2024 that she’d like to see a colossal remix of her theme song from Drake and Sabrina Carpenter.

“My dream remix of my song … I’d like a collaboration between Sabrina Carpenter and, like Drake, if they could come together and do some, like, cool remix of my song, I think that’d be pretty good,” she said. “There’s a little giggle in the beginning, and that could be Sabrina, but then Drake could, like, chime in and, you know, say some cool s–t about me.”

Catch Liv Morgan’s match against Stephanie Vaquer for the Women’s World Championship on Saturday night (April 18) at WrestleMania 42. WrestleMania airs live on the ESPN App for U.S. fans with ESPN Unlimited plans and streams on Netflix for global fans.
